newsitem.title: GERMANY: Chirac arrives in Bonn for talks with Kohl.
newsitem.headline: Chirac arrives in Bonn for talks with Kohl.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac arrived in Bonn on Wednesday for talks with Chancellor Helmut Kohl, but said nothing of substance on his way into a dinner.
Chirac told reporters who met his helicopter upon its arrival that the two men would discuss preparations for Europe's planned single currency and the upcoming European Union summit.
Asked by reporters whether there were any problems in the relationship between Bonn and Paris, Chirac said simply, "No."

Bonn diplomats and officials said the two, whose countries form the core alliance pushing forward European integration, would probably discuss Europe's single currency, EU reform plans and possibly NATO's eastward expansion over dinner.
